privacidad.title: Privacy policy
privacidad.metaDescription: What data SOSColombia collects, how it's used, and how to reach us about privacy.
privacidad.intro1: SOSColombia is an independent, non-profit project verifying and publishing public information about the August 10, 2026 Colombia earthquake. No account or login is required to browse the site.
privacidad.intro2: We never sell personal data to anyone, and never use it for advertising.
privacidad.recopilamosIntro: We only collect personal data when someone voluntarily submits it through the site's forms:
privacidad.recopilamosItem1: "Suggest an aid point": the point's name and address, phone, type of aid, extra context, and, optionally, a contact detail (email or phone) so the submitter can be reached about the request.
privacidad.recopilamosItem2: "Suggest a post" (community): the post's link, extra context, and, optionally, a contact detail from the submitter.
privacidad.recopilamosItem3: The submitter's contact detail is never shown publicly — it's used only internally if a moderator needs to clarify something before publishing the submission.
privacidad.recopilamosItem4: Aggregated, anonymous usage analytics (Vercel Analytics), to understand which pages get visited — it doesn't identify individuals or build personal profiles.
privacidad.tercerosTexto: Some pages show public posts from Instagram, X, TikTok, and Facebook, cited as sources. For Instagram, the site pre-fetches a thumbnail via Meta's public oEmbed API (graph.facebook.com) — that request only sends the post's public link, no personal data about the site visitor. Viewing an embedded post from another platform is subject to that platform's own privacy policy.
privacidad.conservacionTexto: Contact details submitted through a form are kept while the submission is pending review, and for a reasonable time after in case something needs clarifying. You can ask us to delete any personal data you submitted — see how on the
privacidad.contactoTexto: For questions about this policy, reach us on Instagram or open a GitHub issue on the repository — both links are in every page's footer.
